name: claude-folder-janitor
description: Dry-run-first cleanup of ~/.claude: old .claude.json backups, empty session-env folders, a stale changelog cache, and the transcripts of projects whose folders no longer exist. Lists every candidate with size and reason; deletes only on /janitor apply. Never touches skills, plugins, scheduled tasks, settings or history.

pillars.supervised: Dry run is the default and lists every candidate with rule, size and reason; deletion happens only on an explicit /janitor apply, which re-derives the same list and removes exactly those paths
pillars.orchestrated: dry run → review → apply → summary (removed, failed, KB freed, elapsed); one eligibility function per rule decides both the listing and the deletion
pillars.secured: Local filesystem only, no network, no credentials, never sudo; every path is checked to resolve inside ~/.claude under one of four rule roots and never under skills/, plugins/, scheduled-tasks/, CLAUDE.md, settings*.json or history.jsonl
